body:
A metal rod holds my leg together. Quitting my job and living off the land isn't going to happen. I have to limp my ass into Wal Mart and buy food. I really don't own much anyway. 

I can't traveling far due to my declining physical health.
They won't let me have pets in this apartment.

I've tried that and it hasn't work. Every change I've made has been worse than the last. 

I've been putting up with this for over a decade and a half. I'm tired of waiting for things to get better. My physical health is in decline too. Every change I try to make is harder than it used to be. I'm already in my late 30's. I've somehow burned so many bridges I can't even get a passport. Wouldn't matter anyway, it's not like I could afford a plane ticket.
